Brewers report glass, paper and can costs surging and are seeking price increases of 12-15%, while some manufacturers already cut production and raised prices. up_aligarh|hand_tools.f: Limited local coverage. Aligarh's lock and hardware cluster is mostly unorganised and under pressure: the Aligarh Locks and Hardware Association told Frontline that five to 10 manufacturing units are shutting down every day, and one artisan in Moradabad reported getting one or two orders a month. Raw material is the binding constraint — the association says metal prices rose 75 per cent in the last year, and a Bhaskar report puts brass at Rs 950 per kg in 2026 against Rs 550 in 2025. A three-day strike by idol makers over wastage (50 grams versus 10 grams per kg) has hit Diwali orders in a trade the report values at about Rs 500 crore annually. For borrowers, input cost is rising faster than order flow, squeezing cash flow and repayment capacity.
